reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-05' - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-05'
GROUP BY store_code
alternatives: SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-06' AND DATE '2026-01-04' GROUP BY store_code
SELECT s.store_code, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur FROM sales s WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-05' - 30 AND s.order_date <= DATE '2026-01-05' - 1 GROUP BY s.store_code

other_way.sql: SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-06' AND DATE '2026-01-04' GROUP BY store_code
other_way.tradeoff: Typing both end dates reads clearly, but counting back from the as-of date keeps the 30 days visible in the query.
